description: This Java source file defines the class LogView, a custom TextView used to display log data within an Android application. It implements the LogNode interface to format and output log messages, and supports chaining to other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display log messages formatted for readability and supports chaining to other LogNode instances.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data including priority, tag, message, and Throwable, then appends it to the LogView display and forwards it to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
